_comment: Quotation job for Aribell Products Limited (Concord, Ontario, Canada) - door viewers.
Enquiry: 10,000 pcs 180 deg + 1,000 pcs 160 deg, satin nickel, door thickness 1-3/4 in.
Model codes 2614HYG-55 / 1612HYG-5 come from the boss's own draft. They are NOT in the
catalogue (content/products has only DV04-DV12), and the catalogue lists no 160 deg
viewer at all - only 180 / 200. So the final catalogue model is unconfirmed. Per the
boss (2026-09-30: 'if unsure, put them all on') the two priced lines use the DV06 photo
(same body and lens cover as the customer's photo) and every matching DV model is
added below as an unpriced alternative.
Prices are blank: the boss's draft only carries the ex-factory RMB cost, which must
never reach a customer. That cost screenshot was embedded in the draft's unprinted
area (cell I8) and is NOT carried over.
Payment and lead time are the boss's own wording for this deal. Incoterm is carried as he
wrote it (EXW), but 11,000 pcs will exceed USD 10,000 - confirm with him.
Packing: his draft says both 'box packing' and 'bags packing' - left TBC.
